auth.termsRequired: You must accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
auth.temporarySummary: Account and data deleted 7 days after your election.
auth.longTermSummary: Keep your account active by signing in every 6 months.
auth.temporaryNotice: Notice: Temporary Accounts and all associated polling data, candidate media, voter records, and election analytics will be permanently deleted 7 days after your election concludes. Please ensure you export all required reports prior to expiration.
auth.longTermNotice: Notice: Your account profile will remain active indefinitely, provided you log in at least once every 6 months. Historical election results require an active Premium Package subscription to be archived permanently. Free accounts must log in periodically to prevent inactivity purging.
